meta.title: Submit a bid on an eRFX Auction project

steps.note: Open the multi-stage eRFX creation flow.
Provide the required event title so the project can be published.
Configure the project as Auction-only rather than the default stage combination.
Configure the Auction stage before selecting its template and items.
Apply the first available Auction pricing template.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publication.
Invite one QA vendor, representing Vendor A without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the Auction project so the vendor can access it.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Use the supplier portal flow to open the invited Auction event, accept any required terms, enter a quote of 100, and submit it.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Open the buyer comparison grid to observe the live auction result.
Verify the submitted bid is reflected as Rank 1 in the buyer's live comparison.
